rules: 1. hasStudent(X, Y) :- teachesCourse(X, Z), enrolledInCourse(Y, Z)
2. hasStudent(X, Y) :- managesDepartment(X, Z), hasStudent(Z, Y)
3. hasStudent(X, Y) :- advisesStudent(X, Z), isPeerOf(Y, Z)
4. hasStudent(X, Y) :- supervisesProject(X, Z), participatesInProject(Y, Z)
5. hasStudent(X, Y) :- isPartnerInstitution(X, Z), hasStudent(Z, Y)
